options.content:
**What this board shows.** These are **ACME product services** running in the **k6-perf ECS** performance environment (`source="perf"`, `namespace="k6-perf"`, `deployment_environment="perf"`, `platform="ecs"`) — `site-api`, `site-connect`, `sponsor-api`, `sponsor-connect`, `study-web`. It is **not** gardenio platform telemetry: gardenio's own control plane emits **no spanmetrics** into this VictoriaMetrics instance (`span_calls_total{service_name=~"gardenio.*"}` = 0), so every RED overlay below is measuring ACME product traffic, not gardenio.

Spans are relayed from the perf environment into the in-chart gardenio VictoriaTraces (`vtsingle`) and served through the VT-native Jaeger query API. Use the **Service** and **Operation** filters to find traces; click a row to open the full span waterfall.

The **RED overlays** (latency percentiles, duration histogram, throughput, error rate) read the **VictoriaMetrics** OTel spanmetrics (`span_calls_total`, `span_duration_milliseconds_*`), filtered to `span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"` for genuine inbound request-handling. Each RED panel renders an honest **No data** state — never a misleading zero — whenever the selected window has no samples (e.g. the k6-perf load harness is quiescent).

panels.title: Recent traces — $service / $operation
panels.description: Live trace search against VictoriaTraces (Jaeger). Click a row to open the span waterfall. Ground truth: GET /select/jaeger/api/traces?service=<svc>. Default sort is by Duration (slowest first).

panels.title: Server-span latency percentiles — $service
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 inbound (SPAN_KIND_SERVER) latency for $service. histogram_quantile(q, sum by (le) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))). Unit ms (the histogram is _milliseconds). SERVER-kind spanmetrics are federated into VM (ka-0000007075). Honest No-data when the perf load harness is quiescent.

defaults.noValue: No SERVER spanmetrics in the selected window (perf load harness quiescent).

panels.title: Server-span duration distribution — $service
panels.description: Heatmap of the SPAN_KIND_SERVER duration histogram for $service: sum by (le) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])). Shows where request latency concentrates across the 5ms→10s buckets. Honest No-data when the window has no samples.

defaults.noValue: No SERVER spanmetrics in the selected window (perf load harness quiescent).

panels.title: Server-span throughput — $service (requests/sec)
panels.description: sum by (span_name) (rate(span_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) — inbound request rate for $service, broken out by operation (top surfaces). SERVER-kind spanmetrics are federated into VM (ka-0000007075). Honest No-data when the window has no samples.

defaults.noValue: No SERVER spanmetrics in the selected window (perf load harness quiescent).

panels.title: Server-span error rate — $service (errors / requests)
panels.description: Ratio of error server spans (status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) to all server spans for $service — genuine inbound error rate. sum(rate(span_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(span_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",service_name=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9). Unit percentunit (0–1). Honest No-data when the window has no samples.

defaults.noValue: No SERVER spanmetrics in the selected window (perf load harness quiescent).

panels.title: Span p95 — $service

defaults.noValue: no server-span samples for this service — either it served nothing, or span metrics are not being scraped

panels.description: 95th-percentile server-span duration for the selected service, from the OTel span-metrics histogram (the same series the percentile chart above draws).

panels.title: Span throughput — $service

defaults.noValue: no server-span samples for this service — either it served nothing, or span metrics are not being scraped

panels.description: Server-span rate for the selected service (requests/sec).

panels.title: Span error ratio — $service

defaults.noValue: no server-span samples for this service — either it served nothing, or span metrics are not being scraped

panels.description: Fraction of server spans for this service whose status is ERROR, over the same window as the panels above.

panels.title: Span duration by service — p50 / p95 / p99

defaults.noValue: no server-span samples in the window — either nothing was served, or span metrics are not being scraped

panels.description: Cross-service comparison from span metrics: the selected service's tail next to its peers, so 'the API is slow' can be attributed to a service before you open a trace.

title: ACME perf — service traces (k6-perf / ECS, via VictoriaTraces)
description: Trace-derived latency for the perf-monorepo services: recent traces for the selected service/operation, server-span latency percentiles and duration distribution, throughput, and error rate. Open this to go from 'the API is slow' to the specific operation and span that is slow.
